dedupe_keys.name: for a healthy belgium health status indicators and key data in healthcare general hospitals mental healthcare healthcare professionals covid 19 preparedness and response to crisis situations

description: For a Healthy Belgium is a Belgian federal website of indicators on the population's health and on the health care system, published in Dutch, French and English. The pages read on 2026-09-28 cover health status, with burden of disease including the share due to air pollution, extreme temperatures and noise, life expectancy, mortality, diseases and health inequalities, and a set of key data in healthcare reports, each downloadable as a PDF. These describe general hospitals, with their organisation, activity and funding; mental healthcare supply and activity in psychiatric hospitals and hospital departments; the monitoring and planning of the medical workforce; the COVID-19 response, including crisis units and hospital outbreak support; and preparedness and response to crisis situations, covering the care process in a disaster, protocols, required features of ambulances, the Belgian Incident Tracking System and a tactical medical liaison unit. Coverage is Belgium, often by region. Access is free; no licence is stated in the part read, and the publishing bodies behind the site were not identified. Caveats: most content is narrative indicators and reports, not downloadable tables. It supports health service capacity and emergency studies, such as describing hospital surge and medical dispatch arrangements for a mass casualty scenario. Related record: the INAMI-RIZIV health care provider statistics.
